snippet.title: I Won't Finish This Game | ITCH.IO
snippet.description:
Game: I won't finish this game by Naarel
LINK: https://naarel.itch.io/i-wont-finish-this-game

This is told in the eyes of somebody who currently holds or has held suicidal thoughts, he tells you his story of how he sees himself as below everyone else, how there is no point in finishing what he started, I don't know if he is still here with us or not but I'm glad he made this game, brings hard-to-talk-about topics like suicide and depression to light.

#itchio #horrorgaming
